source_full_text: It took them a whole year to reach the shrine, and they passed through many different lands on their way. One day they arrived tired and half-starved in a big city, and said to one another, Let us stay here for a little and rest before we set forth again so they hired a small house close to the royal castle, and took up their abode there.
